name: Out of This World
source:
Travel to Valodia where you'll talk to several girls. Meet and potentially romance any of these beautiful (and maybe a bit strange) women! 

[From [url=https://maritails.itch.io/out-of-this-world]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
前往Valodia，與幾位女孩交談。結識這些美麗、也許還有點古怪的女性，並有機會與其中任何一人發展戀情！

[摘自[url=https://maritails.itch.io/out-of-this-world]itch.io[/url]]
